detail: The Solomon Islands Office of the Auditor General publishes, under its own 'Statutory Authorities' financial-audit listing, the page for the Central Bank of Solomon Islands, which describes 'audits carried out by the Auditor General's Office on the Central Bank of Solomon Islands (CBSI)' and lists CBSI financial statements and audit opinions year by year from 2010 to 2019, with the 2013 and 2014 statements marked 'OAG certified' (27-05-2014 and 30-4-2015). The audit is done by the state audit institution itself; no private firm is named on the page.
source_title: Central Bank of Solomon Islands (CBSI) — Financial Audits of Statutory Authorities (Solomon Islands Office of the Auditor General)

detail: The Independent Auditors' Report in the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu's signed financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2019 is addressed to 'the Board of Directors of Reserve Bank of Vanuatu' and is signed by KPMG, printed as 'KPMG, a Fiji partnership' and 'Chartered Accountants', at Suva, Fiji. The scanned signature line gives the year 2020 but the day and month do not extract legibly.
source_title: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Financial Statements 2019 (signed) (Reserve Bank of Vanuatu)

detail: Cameroon's central bank is the regional Banque des Etats de l'Afrique Centrale (BEAC). The general report of the commissaires aux comptes on BEAC's financial statements for the 2015 financial year is signed jointly by two firms, 'Les Commissaires aux Comptes', at Yaoundé on 11 March 2016. The scanned document is image-based and the two firm names extract imperfectly as 'KPivlG' and 'Mazars Canreroun', i.e. KPMG and Mazars Cameroun, with René Libong, Associé, among the signatories. BEAC's earlier report on the 2013 accounts, signed at Yaoundé on 17 mars 2014, shows MAZARS Cameroun alongside a second firm whose name extracts only as 'ERNST'.
source_title: BEAC — Rapport général des commissaires aux comptes, exercice 2015 (Banque des Etats de l'Afrique Centrale)
